steps.player: Hello? Can you hear me up there?

steps.npc: I hear you, young one. Care to talk? I have a lot of time on my hands.

steps.player: What happened to you? Why are you trapped in a cage?

steps.npc: Hmm. I find myself ruminating on this very question. What happened to me?
Perhaps it is best to ask Yama this question. He will have a stronger opinion than I do.
I see the events from my perspective, but this does not guarantee truth or an accurate answer.
There is little value in tall tales.
Indeed. These bars keep me well away from those fiendish little imps.
Not quite. The recent course of events has surprised me. This is not what I had planned for but I will make the best of it.

options.text: Can I help you at all?

steps.player: Can I help you at all?

steps.npc: Help me? You believe me in need of help? Do you think freedom is some precious thing to me? Vengeance perhaps?
What I would like is for this league to proceed as outlined.

steps.player: Aren't you worried about what will happen to you?

steps.npc: Of course, yet the games go on. Unpleasant circumstances and the volatile beasts that surround me are simply facts I must accept - for now.
